en.summary: Suspected poisoning or overdose needs urgent medical help. NHS: call emergency services; do not make the person vomit unless clinicians tell you to; take the substance packaging if safe. This pack never invents antidote doses (including for paracetamol). Also see carbon-monoxide and alcohol-poisoning entries when relevant.
emergencyIf: Unconscious, fitting, difficulty breathing after ingestion
Child who may have swallowed medicines/household chemicals
seeDoctorIf: Any uncertain ingestion — urgent advice line / emergency pathway
doNot: Do not induce vomiting unless told by clinicians
Do not invent antidote or charcoal regimens
Do not delay calling for help

fr.summary: Toute suspicion d'intoxication/surdose = urgence. Ne pas faire vomir sauf avis. Pas d'antidotes inventés.
doNot: Ne pas faire vomir sans avis

he.summary: חשד להרעלה/מנת יתר — חירום. לא לגרום להקאה אלא אם נאמר. אין נוגדי רעל מומצאים.
emergencyIf: מחוסר הכרה, פרכוס, קושי נשימה אחרי בליעה

ru.summary: Подозрение на отравление/передозировку — неотложка. Не вызывать рвоту без указания. Антидоты не выдумывать.
emergencyIf: Без сознания, судороги, одышка после приёма
